page.content:
Relative security of Eurasian roads under the Mongol khanates.

How Pax Mongolica connects

  • Faction: Mongol Empire — Mongol conquests created the conditions called Pax Mongolica.
  • Character: Marco Polo — Polo's journey is the famous European use of the Mongol-era roads.

What is Pax Mongolica?

Pax Mongolica names the thirteenth- and fourteenth-century window when Italian, Persian, and Chinese travelers could move farther under Mongol safe-conduct than under the fractured states before and after.

Key threads lead to Mongol Empire and Marco Polo.
